stations.note: DEC-039: 11 numbered stations (register 1 is the BOH desk, DEC-040); positions from ROOM_FIXTURES rev7 POS_ rows (REF-011): (x, y) = station centre on the counter's staff edge, staff = compass side of the budtender. Operator/call anchors: SCENE_ANCHORS.json.

stand.note: REF-003 REFERENCES_INDEX 2.2 (DEC-021/026): chrome wire stand against the staff side of the counter, to the staff's right of the POS monitor (offsetT along the staff's right, every station). Footprint 1.6 W x 1.3 D (Low-Med); top tray 2.5 ft (Low, hangs on the counter convention GAP-108); 1 wire shelf in the bottom third (Med); 1 bench scale (Med); clear acrylic panel full stand width on the counter-side edge, ~1 ft tall (position Med, size Low).

jarSlots.note: ART-007: three deli walls (REFERENCES_INDEX 8.3) from ROOM_FIXTURES rev7: per wall a counter run (back counter top, jars on it) and two tier runs (4.25 / 5.5 ft, GAP-002 placeholders). Slots are numbered by a seeded weighted draw (seed; fill = 8.4 occupied share per row), so the first N slots that gameplay stocks fill the walls unevenly: top tier dense, middle patchy, counter row sparse.
